name: Task_InitRoot
notes: current = root 0x007DF878, dead list 0x007DF8AC = 0, unlink root post list (0x004A7120), root fn 0 / alive 1 / serial 0, init(), returns current; callers run Mem_Init first

name: Task_Create
notes: Mem_Alloc(size); zero 0x34-byte header; parent = current's parent (root if current is root/NULL) -> flat list; append at tail; serial = 0x00598AA8++ (init 0x10000); alive = 1. Verified vs capture K lines (518 frames)

name: Task_Kill
notes: Unlink current, current = parent, push on dead list 0x007DF8AC (serial = alive = 0), longjmp(0x007DF838,-1); next left intact. Inlined in several actor fns

name: Task_FreeDead
notes: Mem_Free(task[9]) and Mem_Free(task) for every dead task; called by 0x004ABED0 after the frame

name: Task_UnlinkTree
notes: Recursively unlinks current's +0x24 list and current; used by Task_InitRoot on the root

name: Task_Run
notes: Recursive: children (+0x28 list), setjmp(0x007DF838), fn(task) unless low byte of +0x32 == 0xFF (then cleared), post list (+0x24); current = NULL on return

name: Task_RunFrom
notes: current = t; Task_Run (per frame with the root from Task_InitRoot)

name: Task_Current
notes: returns 0x007DF8B0

name: Task_SetUser
notes: task+0x10 = p

name: Task_Clear
notes: Zeroes the task block from +0x34 to its end (size from the heap header at -0x10)

name: Mem_Init
notes: (Re)creates the 16 MB task heap (malloc 0x100000F, aligned), one free block, zeroes the root header 0x007DF878

name: Mem_Free
notes: Frees a Mem_Alloc block, coalescing with free neighbours

name: Mem_AllocZero
notes: Mem_Alloc + memset 0

name: Evt_SetFlag
notes: Opcode 0x48: 0x009C7200[arg] = 1 (prop trigger / kill flags)

name: Evt_SpawnList0B
notes: Opcode 0x0B: for each record pointer until -1: Actor_SpawnRecord0B(0x0045EBB0(p))

name: Evt_SpawnList0C
notes: Opcode 0x0C: same with Actor_SpawnRecord0C

name: Evt_Ptr
notes: identity (pointer translation stub)

name: Actor_Remove
notes: flags = flags & ~1 | 0x80018000; 0x00405220(a); clears lock-on slot 0x009C88C0[a+0x3C] if a+0x38 & 0x40; Task_Kill

name: Hit_Register
notes: If !(flags & 0x8000) and (flags & 0x10 or view z +0x78 <= 0): (flags & 0x10: +0x150 = camera matrix 0x009A6040[cam] * +0x150) append {a, flags, +0x12C, +0x130, +0x134} to 0x0059D8E8 (count 0x005A4C80)

name: Actor_Komono
notes: Type 0x41: ctor table 0x00593580[kind +0x130C] (79 entries), then Task_Kill

name: Komono_CtorGeneric
notes: 50 kinds: Task_Create(0x005936BC[kind], 0x378) (per-frame fn table, 79 entries); pos, rot -> +0x1CC/+0x1D0/+0x1D4, +0x28C/+0x11C = state; per-kind switch (rand for several). Kind 45 -> 0x0046DAB0 (verified)

name: Komono_CtorBreakable
notes: Kind 4: breakable prop task 0x00465FB0; sub-kind = rot[2]; row 0x00593DB8; item counter 0x009C7010[slot] = rand() % rot[0] + 1. Verified (65600)

name: Actor_Type44
notes: State table 0x00595AB8[+0x11C] (18 states), then Task_Kill

name: Prop44_CtorHanging
notes: State 1: hanging prop task 0x00473CF0 from params (kind, model, hit id, amp, phase, trigger/kill flags). Verified

name: Prop44_CtorHangingRow
notes: State 2: several hanging props (kind 2, model 0x1794+n) placed along RotY

name: Prop44_CtorAnimated
notes: State 3: task 0x00474120 (prop skeleton 0xB, motion 0x1D6, model 0x17EE / 0x197C). Verified

name: Prop44_CtorHangingScaled
notes: State 4: hanging prop with scale (params +0x14..) and amp at params +0xC

name: Prop44_CtorBreakable
notes: State 15: breakable prop task 0x00465FB0 (lifetime, item slot, +0x2A0 from params); rand() at 0x00473912 for the item counter. Verified (65598/65599)

name: Prop_HangingUpdate
notes: Hanging prop per frame: kill flag, trigger animation tables 0x005960B4/0x005960C8 (60/130 frames), shot swing (16 frames), W = S Rx Ry Rz Ry(base) T, Hit_Register. Ported: game::HangingProp (1024 draws, max err 1.5e-4)

name: Prop_AnimatedUpdate
notes: Motion-driven prop: frame++ while trigger flag, sounds, prop skeleton with model override + stored node matrix, Hit_Register. Ported: game::AnimatedProp

name: Prop_BreakableUpdate
notes: Breakable prop (pots/crates): lifetime, shot -> break animation / score / sound / spark / item, shake (rand x2), prop skeleton or static model, shadow 0x10D0/0x10D1, hit point. Ported: game::BreakableProp (21209 draws)

name: Prop_CheckLifetime
notes: Stage 1 + flag 0x77 -> Actor_Remove; counts changes of 0x009A2BB0, removes after +0x11C changes

name: Prop_ScoreShot
notes: Shooter = (flags & 2) == 0, rand() & 1 when both gun bits; score 0x004156C0(p, 10); hit counter 0x009A5C86[p*0x98]++

name: Prop_SpawnHitSpark
signature: void __cdecl (Task* t, int player, float scale)
notes: Task 0x004667A0 (0x50): sprite 0xE25 at the screen-projected hit point

name: Prop_SpawnBoxEffect
notes: Task 0x00465950 (sprite 0x904); used when model 0x19E8 is shot

name: Prop_DecorKind45
notes: Fixed decor models 5937-5941 (table 0x005949F8/0x00594A50, y 65) + vertex wave on models 0x1731-0x1734 (phase +0x1D0). Ported: game::DecorKind45 (4096 draws)

name: PropSkel_Draw
notes: Prop skeleton draw, normal model select

name: PropSkel_DrawAlt
notes: Prop skeleton draw via Mdl_SelectAlt 0x004185E0

name: PropSkel_DrawStore
signature: void __cdecl (PropAnim* a, char storeIndex, int model)
notes: Override model; store matrix of node index storeIndex at a+0x14

name: PropSkel_Walk
notes: Clamp frame (>= ticks-1 -> 0, < 0 -> ticks-2), walk root 0x004D5390[type] children with 0x0040DE50, prevFrame = frame

name: PropSkel_DrawNode
notes: push; index >= 1: node transform 0x0040D9D0, model 0x10CE random scale (rand), draw, optional store; children; pop

name: PropSkel_NodeTransform
notes: Mode 0x004D5440[type]: 0 per tick, else 30 Hz with half-step lerp; M = Rx Ry Rz T(pos) * M; mode 2 big-angle case -> 0x00412750 (not ported)

name: PropSkel_FramePos
notes: 0x009A37E0[motion*2] + 4 + frame * ((18*count - 15) & ~3)

name: PropSkel_FrameRot
notes: FramePos + 12*(count-1)

name: Mtx_InterpolateRot
notes: Half-way rotation between two matrices (axis/angle via fpatan); used by prop skeleton mode 2

name: Mtx_Multiply
notes: Current = m * current

name: Mtx_TransformPoint
notes: out = in * current (row vector)

name: Mtx_LoadIdentity
notes: Copies identity 0x00571210 to the current matrix

name: Mtx_Store
notes: Copies the current matrix to dst (task +0x150 = model-view of the prop; equals the captured M line)

name: Mdl_Draw_Id
notes: Draws a global model id with the current matrix (the M lines); 0x004185E0 alternate variant

name: Actor_Civilian
notes: Type 0x10: allocates 0xC4 state, enemy skeleton, sub-records via 0x00408A20, sets fn 0x0048A920 / 0x0048B140; shooting it: 0x004156C0(p,-100)
